How to get arrested in cybersecurity 💀

Getting caught isn’t a single moment — it’s a process.
Built slowly through patterns, behavior, and small inconsistencies that go unnoticed… until they don’t.
In cybersecurity, most people don’t fail because of advanced tracking.
They fail because they underestimate how much they reveal over time.
.
